version_change_rationale: r11 — Introducción de taxonomía RC-I/RC-A/RC-P, familia INST, Instrument Validation Matrix. Cambio de paradigma: Motor→Resultado a Instrumento→Validación→Experimento→Evidence Ledger→Claim.

DIAG.purpose: Diagnostic — localize problems without modifying code

VAL.purpose: Validation of measurement instruments (DEPRECATED — subsumed by INST)
VAL.note: VAL-0001 fue el primer experimento de validación de instrumentos. La familia INST generaliza esta idea. VAL-0001 es el antecedente de INST-0002.

INST.purpose: Instrument validation — certify that measurement tools are reliable

categories.RC-I: Instrument — problems with measurement instruments (Dataset Builder, Judge, RVS, FQS)
categories.RC-A: Algorithm — problems with recovery algorithms (parsers, deduplication, delimitation)
categories.RC-P: Protocol — problems with experimental protocol (hypothesis, claim, threshold)

RC-A-002.title: BMP false positive causes dedup cascade

RC-A-003.title: Scale-dependent recovery collapse
RC-A-003.status: ROOT_CAUSE_IDENTIFIED — explained by BMP false positive + PDF footer

summary.Carving Parser: 🔬 DIAGNOSED (INST-0002: BMP false positive → dedup cascade, PDF footer truncation)

EXP-0001.name: Baseline Stability Characterization
EXP-0001.question: Is the laboratory deterministic under identical conditions?
EXP-0001.answer: YES — SD=0 for all result metrics. Runtime is the only varying metric.

EXP-0002.name: Seed Variation Reproducibility
EXP-0002.question: Does CLAIM-001 depend on a lucky seed?
EXP-0002.answer: NO — MFT-First > Carving across all 4 seeds (42, 1337, 2026, 9999).

key_findings.new_finding: Carving is NOT always OU=0 on healthy images (0.0028-0.0080)

EXP-0003.name: Cross-Machine Reproduction
EXP-0003.question: Does the laboratory produce the same results on another machine?
EXP-0003.answer: Same-machine verification PASSED. Cross-machine execution PENDING.

EXP-0004.name: Dataset Scaling Robustness
EXP-0004.question: Does the laboratory work beyond toy 10 MB datasets?
EXP-0004.answer: NOT YET EXECUTED (requires longer runtime for 1 GB datasets).

EXP-0005.name: External Strategy Validation
EXP-0005.question: Where does RecoveryLab sit in the strategy space?
EXP-0005.answer: MFT-First degrades gracefully with corruption (0.9589 → 0.5508 → 0.1794). Carving shows OU=0.0 on ALL corruption variants. No crossover detected. External tool comparison pending.

key_findings.carving_motor_weakness: Carving motor does not recover files even on corrupted images

EXP-SD0.name: SD=0 Diagnostic Investigation
EXP-SD0.question: Why is SD=0 in EXP-0001?
EXP-SD0.answer: EXPLANATION_2: OU is quantized (discrete file counts, fixed RVS profiles). Runtime IS the only varying metric (SD=3.2ms).

key_findings.explanation: OU quantization: discrete file counts × fixed RVS profiles = deterministic composites

DIAG-0001.name: Carving Zero Origin Diagnostic
DIAG-0001.question: Why does Carving Motor produce OU=0.0?
DIAG-0001.answer: 3/5 parsers work perfectly (ZIP=1.0, DOCX=1.0, PNG≈0.87). 2 have local implementation defects: RC-A-001 (PDF 1-byte) and RC-A-002 (JPEG dedup).

VAL-0001.name: Parser Validation at Scale
VAL-0001.question: Do individual parsers work correctly at N=100?
VAL-0001.answer: NO — Recovery collapses at scale. ZIP 17%, DOCX 40%, PNG 70%, PDF 0%, JPEG 1%. This invalidated DIAG-0001's conclusion that '3 parsers work'.

key_findings.paradigm_shift: VAL-0001 invalidated a previous conclusion of the lab itself — exactly what a healthy scientific system should do

VAL-0001.note: VAL-0001 subsumido por INST-0002 (Carving Parser validation). VAL-0001 es el antecedente directo.

INST-0001.name: Dataset Builder Validation
INST-0001.question: Does the Dataset Builder produce realistic, non-adversarial layouts?
INST-0001.answer: YES — H6 REFUTED. Dataset Builder generates correct, non-adversarial layouts. 13/13 V1-V4 pass, 3/3 V6 determinism pass.

INST-0002.name: Carving Parser Pipeline Loss Localization
INST-0002.question: ¿En qué etapa exacta del pipeline desaparece cada archivo?
INST-0002.answer: Two root causes identified: (1) BMP false positive (50MB) → dedup cascade eliminates real files (44.6% loss), (2) PDF footer truncation (1 byte) → SHA-256 mismatch (24.6% loss). Scanner and delimitation work correctly (0% loss).

key_findings.H3_dedup_loss: SUPPORTED — 44.6% eliminated by dedup (BMP false positive cascade)

INST-0003.name: Judge Validation
INST-0003.question: Does the Judge produce correct verdicts without bias?

INST-0004.name: RVS Validation
INST-0004.question: Are RVS weights calibrated with human judgment?

INST-0005.name: FQS Validation
INST-0005.question: Are FQS thresholds empirically valid? Is 1-byte diff FUNCTIONAL or FAILED?

key_insights: 1. The laboratory is deterministic under identical conditions (EXP-0001, EXP-0002, EXP-SD0)
2. SD=0 is genuine for result metrics — OU is quantized from integer file counts (EXP-SD0)
3. CLAIM-001 does NOT depend on seed=42 — it's robust across 4 seeds (EXP-0002)
4. Carving motor is NOT always OU=0 on healthy images — sometimes recovers tiny amounts (EXP-0002)
5. Carving motor does NOT recover files even on corrupted images — implementation weakness (EXP-0005)
7. No crossover detected between MFT-First and Carving under current conditions (EXP-0005)
8. The bottleneck is NOT engineering — it's converting observations into independent evidence (auditor r8)
9. VAL-0001 invalidated a previous conclusion of the lab — exactly what a healthy scientific system should do (auditor r11)
10. RC-A-003 is NOT a deduplication defect — it's a scale-dependent recovery collapse with multiple compatible hypotheses (auditor r11)
11. The paradigm shifted from 'Motor → Result' to 'Instrument → Validation → Experiment → Evidence Ledger → Claim' (auditor r11)
12. INST-0002 localized the exact loss stage for every file: 0% at scan, 0% at delimitation, 44.6% at dedup, 24.6% at judge (INST-0002)
13. The BMP signature 'BM' (2 bytes) creates a 50MB false positive that eliminates real files via dedup cascade — this is the primary root cause of RC-A-003 (INST-0002)
14. RC-A-003 is NOT a scale-dependent algorithmic property — it's a constant-size bug whose impact scales with N because the BMP false positive overlaps with more files at higher density (INST-0002)
